name: Pixel painting with shape recognition
description: Paint on the grid as before. Say “recognize” to find every contour in the painted boxes and trace it with rails, including inner contours such as the inside edge of a rectangle drawn within another rectangle.

levels.name: Canvas
levels.intro: Canvas. Bring Me to It to paint. Say a colour or erase. Say “recognize” to find every contour in the painted grid and trace it with a rail, including inner contours.

levels.name: Trace
levels.intro: Trace. Paint, then say show red to feel it. Say “recognize” to find every contour in the painted grid and trace it with a rail, including inner contours.

levels.name: Fine canvas
levels.intro: Fine canvas. Smaller cells. Say “recognize” to find every contour in the painted grid and trace it with a rail, including inner contours.
